point_model: frozen V8 weekday84, no point forecast tuning
development_ports: eight previously viewed V5 operational cohort
earliest_origin: 2026-01-08 after full2025 development and assumed7day publication lag

aci.updates: only once when previously issued forecast target truth is published at target+7days; no future residuals

local_calibration: per-port past residuals with at least60 observed points; prior year for frozen; causal moving90/180/365day windows for others
selection: minimize development port-horizon full-year plus quarter failures of original coverage>=.8 and mean normalized width<=2; then mean normalized WIS; then width. All candidates and failures retained.
new_port_gate: no test-based tuning; all observed scores and hold rates published; WIS must not worsen vs global V8 on mean port/horizon; individual failures retained
independence: seven unused ports selected by metadata only; extracted after candidate/source freeze. Same pinned IMF export. Per-port historical calibration is allowed, not zero-shot. No historic publication SLA proof. Bounded delayed ACI not claimed to retain unrestricted theoretical guarantees.
